title: Hand Off Physical-iPhone Debugging Between Macs
summary: Alex Reeder describes running six remote agent sessions on a Mac mini, synchronizing the resulting commit to a MacBook attached to his iPhone, and asking Codex to hand debugging to a new local agent. Computer use then operates Xcode and captures the device screen to confirm state, avoiding manual screenshot transfer while keeping physical-device testing local.
takeaway: Separate scalable coding from device-bound validation: hand a commit and a precise test task to the Mac connected to the phone, then require captured screen state from the local debugging agent.
